claims: n90/n90_exact.json states 90 unit squares as [center_x, center_y, cos, sin] rows of exact rationals, (cos, sin) the unit direction of one edge, with the side 199880777150913904183/20000000000000000000; the issue and the root README round it up at 12 places as 9.994038857546, and n90/README.md prints 9.99403885754569520915. n90/n90_witness.yaml states the same packing as a packing.squares:Witness/v2 document of rational corners with the softschema envelope and a claim block of coordinate_provenance reported. The issue and n90/README.md compare the side with the record's 9.998277166926 at 90 (T-303), an improvement of 0.00424.

n90/README.md and the issue say the packing starts from T-303, which jazivxt built from a crop of the source's n = 157 packing: T-303 has a cluster of 49 squares that lean away from the axes inside a frame of axis-aligned squares; a local search changed small groups of squares in position and angle, optimized the packing again after each change and kept the changes that gave a smaller side; in the new packing the cluster has 37 leaning squares, seven squares in the upper left of the cluster have a new angle, and five squares along the left wall are axis-aligned. They say a linear program over all 90 squares, with every contact linearized at the solution, found no first-order improvement larger than 4e-10, that the certificate keeps a smallest gap of 1e-12 between squares, and that the local optimum has no formal proof. They say a public merged Kaggle submission (bestbryant/claude_code_squaresinsquares, 15 November 2026) lists 9.998277166917 for n = 90 and that the leaderboard's best sides were not available.

verify_exact.py (separating axes) and check_area.py (the area of each close pair's clipped intersection), both Python's fractions.Fraction and its standard library only, are the folder's two exact checkers; #996 says they have one author and read the same input file but share no code, each reports 90 squares and 202 close pairs, this repository's check_rational_witness_independent.py at ed7aff6 reports 'VERIFIED: 90 squares, 4005 pairs' on the witness, and the witness validates against this repository's witness.schema.yaml.
